The records for the IACUC semiannual reports and recommendations, the letter to the IO (Institutional Official), and the

narrative:
2.35(f) 
   
Recordkeeping requirements. 
The records for the IACUC semiannual reports and recommendations, the letter to the IO (Institutional Official), and the 
PVC (Program of Veterinary Care) are not accessible for review at the time of inspection. Inspection of these records is 
necessary for evaluation of compliance under the Animal Welfare Act where all required records must be available for 
inspection by authorized APHIS representatives. A system should be implemented to ensure that all records and reports 
are available during inspections and maintained by the facility for at least three years. To be corrected from this date, 
28JUL2026 forward. 
 
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
